{{Top|leg}}
'''Fiber-lights''' were illumination devices for outside use. The walkways leading to [[16AA889 Starfield Road]] were lined with strings of color-adjustable fiber-lights. The lights were fitted with [[fiber-optic]] visual pickups that were linked to security monitors and the house's [[Supervisor droid/Legends|operations droid]], [[HC55-903]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
